notes.title: Extended Demo Re-release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45040267/07e8f570e3cd45cdee14dd836492b6b914ace1bc.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

The updated demo for Past the Moon; Towards the Sun is finally here, and it brings a ton of improvements and new content! I’ve worked hard to refine the experience, and this update includes story revisions, new artwork, and extended gameplay—including Chapter 1!

[b]Whats New![/b]

[list]
[*] Entire narrative has been rewritten in third-person for a more immersive storytelling experience.
[*] Updated character models, rigging and animation
[*] Updated backgrounds
[*] New character models
[*] New backgrounds
[*] New music
[*] New sound FXs
[*] New Achievement
[*] Updated Steam store page, including trailer!
[/list]

Performance tweaks and bug fixes.

If you’ve played before, this is the perfect time to revisit the game and see what’s changed!

Thank you for all your support! Let us know what you think of the new demo—we’d love your feedback!

Wishlist, play, and stay tuned for more updates!

Join the[url= https://discord.gg/WE5azhE9jB ] Discord[/url] for updates
